against.text: The instruments with teeth were removed: the Schumer-Rounds review board and eminent domain provisions were struck in conference, and the 2024 refiling of the complete Act was ordered to lie on the table.

The agencies most often alleged to hold records have not placed them in the collection: as of 28 August 2026 CIA, DIA, DOE, NASA, NRO, NGA, DHS, the Army and the Navy had no series in Record Group 615, which the board infers means they have not sent them, since ODNI's own 2021 contributor list contradicts the alternative that they hold none.

The PURSUE releases cannot settle anything as published: the Department attaches no comment or assessment to any file; Christopher Mellon said releasing raw files without context may confuse more than clarify, and Tim Gallaudet and Alejandro Rojas said the missing metadata and coordinates make it impossible to conclude anything was anomalous or make independent analysis very difficult; the Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies found the first release stripped time, location, range and altitude and contained nothing from DOE, DIA, NRO, NSA or CIA.

Contractors answer to their sponsors, not to Congress: MITRE said that if relevant material is found it will coordinate with the federal agencies responsible for the work, and on the board's reading no UAP subpoena has issued from House Oversight across three hearings.

The measurements already made point one way: AARO's Oak Ridge analyses found the specimens terrestrial or conventional, and the IM1 spherules claim by independent astronomers was contested in the peer-reviewed literature, with the seismic signal used to locate the search attributed to truck traffic.

Some officials consider the question already answered: HPSCI Chairman Mike Turner said the whistleblowers repeatedly had to say they did not actually have any knowledge, and AARO attributes the reverse-engineering claim largely to circular reporting.

answer.text: For material, the Nolan-Vallee methodology paper specifies isotope ratio measurement as the discriminating test. Everything on the board that has been tested came back terrestrial, conventional or an unknown industrial process, and on the board's reading AARO's specimens were surrendered voluntarily and cannot carry a general negative about holdings it has never inspected.

For records, sections 1841 to 1843 of the FY2024 NDAA bar destruction or alteration of any UAP record, required each agency to review and organise its UAP records for disclosure and transfer within 300 days, and require full disclosure within 25 years unless the President certifies harm. Postponement is decided by the original classification authority, with no independent board.

For witnesses, ODNI memorandum ES 2026-00818, signed by the Principal Deputy Director of National Intelligence, directs release of all UAP information to the PURSUE Task Force and waives prior NDAs for current and former employees and contractors speaking with AARO or PURSUE.

For contractors, on the board's reading no enacted instrument yet reaches their holdings. The House-adopted FY2027 amendment would add a Senate-confirmed review board with subpoena power and extend disclosure to covered contractors, while the Senate's FY2027 bill as reported carries no UAP provisions.

for.text: The collection statute is binding law: records must be open for inspection at the National Archives within 30 days of transmission and online within a further 180, and NARA has established Record Group 615 under it.

The ODNI memorandum requires every intelligence element to name a PURSUE designee within 30 days and to tell its workforce that previous NDAs prohibiting disclosure to the President or designees like PURSUE are no longer in force.

A member of Congress has asked a contractor directly: Burlison's May 2026 letter, which his office calls the first congressional records demand to an FFRDC operator on UAP, demanded all MITRE UAP and reverse-engineering records back to 1930 in native format with complete metadata, and MITRE confirmed it was reviewing its archives.

Section 1687(b) makes UAP-related contractor research unallowable as an overhead cost unless disclosed to the committees and leadership; none of the prime contractors on the board has publicly reported such a disclosure.

Independent instruments exist that no agency controls: the Galileo Project's founders published its overview in the Journal of Astronomical Instrumentation in 2023, and the VASCO search compares sky-survey plates exposed in 1949 to 1957, before any satellite, against modern surveys.

lead.text: Two things could settle the question where testimony cannot: physical material measured by a falsifiable test, and records produced by the agencies and contractors said to hold them. The law now orders the records collected at the National Archives, but the independent review board and the power to take privately held material were removed before it passed, and the agencies decide what to postpone.

open: Will CIA, DIA, NRO, NGA and DOE, all addressees of the ODNI memorandum, ever place a series in Record Group 615?
Will the Senate take up the House-adopted successor, and will its contractor reach survive conference?
Where does testimony from legacy program personnel go now that the Board that was to receive it does not exist?
Does the NDA waiver cover testimony given to Congress, and will contractor holdings ever reach the releases?
Does any of the material Nolan has examined carry a documented federal chain of custody, and where would that documentation be held?

threads.text: The oversight thread ends at a contractor. Burlison's May 2026 letter to MITRE demanded records back to 1930 with a 45-day deadline, MITRE said it would coordinate any production with the federal agencies responsible for the work, and the House-adopted FY2027 amendment extends disclosure to covered government contractors; on the board's reading it is the only instrument that would reach the holdings he asked MITRE for.
